quiz.title: SQL DDL & DML Syntax True/False Quiz
quiz.description: 20 simple True/False questions testing SQL syntax correctness for SELECT, UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE, CREATE, ALTER, and DROP statements.

question.text:
True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
SELECT name, age FROM Students WHERE age > 18;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
SELECT FROM Students WHERE age > 18;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
INSERT INTO Users (name, email) VALUES ('Alice', 'alice@example.com');

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
INSERT Users (name, email) VALUES ('Bob', 'bob@example.com');

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
UPDATE Products SET price = 25 WHERE id = 10;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
UPDATE Products VALUE price = 25 WHERE id = 10;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
DELETE FROM Employees WHERE status = 'Inactive';

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
DELETE * FROM Employees WHERE status = 'Inactive';

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
CREATE TABLE Orders (id INT PRIMARY KEY, amount DECIMAL(10,2));

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
CREATE NEW TABLE Orders (id INT, amount DECIMAL);

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
ALTER TABLE Customers ADD phone VARCHAR(20);

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
ALTER TABLE Customers INSERT phone VARCHAR(20);

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
DROP TABLE Old_Logs;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
DELETE TABLE Old_Logs;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
SELECT title, price FROM Books ORDER BY price DESC;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
SELECT title, price FROM Books WHERE ORDER BY price;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
UPDATE Members SET status = 'Active', WHERE id = 5;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
ALTER TABLE Employees DROP COLUMN temp_address;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
DROP DATABASE Test_DB;

True or False: Is this SQL statement syntactically correct?
INSERT INTO Items (code, name) SET ('A10', 'Widget');
